title: Buddy teaches himself piano
summary: Buddy began playing the house piano before Monk took up bass, without any lessons; Monk secretly tried it with no result.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: Did he take up music because of you guys?
No, because Buddy started before I did.
See, there was a piano in the house. I remember Buddy practicing
So all of you were self-taught?

Yeah. Buddy just, it came very natural for Buddy. Because I remember when Buddy went to the army. He went to the army; before going to the army, I used to...I was always amazed by that. And that was before I started playing. Buddy and I wasn't, like I said, never really hung out and I'm... later I began to be more able to give it some thought, and I felt bad about it but I didn't know what to do about it. I never really knew what to do about it. I always feel...I guess it was pretty much the same with him, just the way we were brought up, we were just caught in that particular trap, being split up, the circumstances. But I remember him playing, very distinctly.

He must have been 15, 16. And as he began to play, it looked like he...I used to...when I was always saying, 'How did that guy, how did it happen? How can he sit there and play that piano? Just sit down and play the piano?' I knew he wasn't getting any schooling or training or teaching. And before he went to the army, he was playing things on that piano. And I remember when nobody wasn't there, there was nobody around, I'd look around and make sure nobody was there and I'd go to the

piano. And I was never...There was no piano where I was raised with my dad, or anything like that. And I'd go to the piano. And be kind of saying, 'Maybe if I just take it serious, something will happen here, because it will come back to me.'
